map.NAFLD FibroScan 纤维化与脂肪变性评估 使用指南: NAFLD FibroScan fibrosis and steatosis assessment guide
map.算法：LSM <8kPa → F0-F1（排除显著纤维化，NPV>90%）、8~: Algorithm: LSM <8 kPa -> F0-F1 (rules out significant fibrosis, NPV>90%), 8-10 -> F2, 10-15 -> F3, >=15 kPa -> F4 (cirrhosis); CAP <248 -> S0, ...
map.纤维化分期：由 LSM(kPa) 定 F0-F4，区分是否肝硬化: Fibrosis staging: determine F0-F4 from LSM (kPa) and identify whether cirrhosis is present
map.脂肪变分级：由 CAP(dB/m) 定 S0-S3，指导减重与用药: Steatosis grading: determine S0-S3 from CAP (dB/m) to guide weight loss and medication
map.联合判断：LSM≥15 直接按 F4 管理，筛查静脉曲张与肝癌: Combined judgment: manage LSM >= 15 directly as F4 and screen for varices and liver cancer
map.S3 建议积极减重与代谢管理: S3 recommends active weight loss and metabolic management
map.LSM 受什么影响会偏高？: What can make LSM falsely high?
map.急性肝炎、肝淤血（右心衰）、胆汁淤积、进食后及肥胖者皮下脂肪厚均可使 LSM 假: Acute hepatitis, hepatic congestion (right heart failure), cholestasis, recent food intake and thick subcutaneous fat in obesity can all falsely raise LSM; the operator must obtain at least 10 valid consecutive measurements in the same plane with IQR/median <= 0.3 for the result to be reliable. When in doubt, combine FIB-4, APRI and imaging.
map.CAP 能代替活检看脂肪变吗？: Can CAP replace biopsy for assessing steatosis?
map.CAP 无创反映肝脏脂肪变程度，与受控衰减参数一致好，但受探头部（M/XL）与炎: CAP non-invasively reflects the degree of hepatic steatosis and agrees well with the controlled attenuation parameter, but it is affected by the probe type (M/XL) and inflammation, so it cannot replace biopsy for assessing inflammation and ballooning (NASH activity). S3 recommends active weight loss and metabolic management.
